scope: Exact frozen B1 RTL reproduction; B0/B1/B2 build selection and output isolation

B0_source.origin: Exact base-commit source; includes disabled SWAY_BLOCK_PROFILE instrumentation

incorrect_reproduction_attempt.reason: Current B2 package still emits 11 unused completionGroupCnt registers with constant-false enables under B1 and changes compiler-generated names/mux forms. Differences are not comments only; its physical timing was not measured.

exact_B1_reproduction.normalization: Replace the single generated line matching ^// On .*$ with // On <normalized>; preserve all other bytes

limitations: This check does not reroute a design or extend timing evidence to different RTL. B1 evidence applies to the exact frozen source and reproduced RTL; B2 keeps its measured current source. B0 uses the source of its existing internal-profile baseline.
output_isolation: B1/B2 use sibling directories with -B1/-B2 suffixes, so blueyosys deleting legacy B0 build/bsim directories cannot delete their variant builds.

selected_source_manifest_validation.coverage: Backward-compatible default source plus internal and external selected package manifests; unselected main SwayLinear package excluded.
